_comment: Example for scripts/phone-sheet.py (the Instafill 16:9 Desk Demo, variant A, 2026-11-24). Copy into projects/<id>/; paths are beside the spec. phone: the screen track (1080x2400), sheet: page-tour.py's output at the card's size. sheet_from: the section second the filled PDF opens on the phone (read it off the rendered phone track with ffprobe -- edl-cut frame-rounds each segment, so a sum of the EDL is ~0.1 s off). dur: the phone track's real duration.
